name: Ealtic
summary:
Ealtic is a mixed reality app that lets people experience and learn the wisdom, stories, and traditions behind ancient Indian culture in an interactive and immersive way. Step into timeless stories, celebrate vibrant festivals, and experience the wisdom of tradition in a whole new way. Using hand tracking, you interact directly with characters, sacred objects, and festive rituals - right in your own space.
